findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are embedded as plaintext Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived credentials to anyone with read access to the function configuration (GetFunction/console/Terraform state).
The function uses the nodejs12.x runtime, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches, so known vulnerabilities in the runtime and its bundled dependencies remain unpatched.
